card.name: Route words before treatment items
card.fires_on: Route or administration words such as 'intravenous' (at 'intr|avenous'), 'oral', and sometimes 'for' or 'medical' just before a drug, dosing device, or care item. Seen in emergency-readiness lists and preparation steps.

modes.label: Intravenous in emergency lists
modes.description: The word 'intravenous' is split partway through, in lists of anaphylaxis rescue agents.

modes.label: Oral before dosing or ingestion
modes.description: The word 'oral' comes before glucose, dosing syringe, dosing device, or ingestion.
modes.example: Five subjects required<< oral>> glucose following the ingestion of glyburide

modes.label: Preparation wording
modes.description: A linking word in vial-mixing steps or a modifier before support.
